title: QBR segmentation sandbox: deployment x ICP x region (WIP)
body:
Purpose:
This sandbox doc collects a minimal, operational segmentation rubric we can iterate on for QBR prioritization and renewal outreach. Goal is to have a lightweight scoring system that combines: tier (contract size / strategic value), ICP fit, deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private), region/regulatory sensitivity, and short-term activity signals (usage trend, errors, infra incidents).

Scope and audience:
- Owners: CS account managers and Renewal specialists
- Consumers: EMs, Solutions Eng, RevOps for quarterly planning
- Not final: this is intended to be a working rubric and example data for the Feb QBR pilot

How to use this sheet (ops flow):
1) Pull latest usage/ARR/incident metrics from RevOps dashboard and SRE incident feed (weekly).
2) Score each account across the dimensions below.
3) Compute composite priority score and bucket into Priority 1/2/3 for QBR owners.
4) Attach suggested playbook actions and set owner for pre-QBR outreach.

Segmentation dimensions and scoring (proposed):
- Tier (ARR / strategic): A=100 pts, B=60 pts, C=20 pts
  - Quick mapping: >= $1M => A, $250k–$1M => B, < $250k => C
- ICP fit (product fit and buying persona): 0–30 pts
  - 30 = Excellent match (primary ICP + 2+ use cases live), 15 = partial fit, 0 = low fit
- Deployment mode (operational risk / revenue concentration): 0–25 pts
  - Private/on-prem/VPC = 25 (higher operational complexity), Dedicated = 15, Hosted = 5
- Region / regulatory sensitivity: 0–15 pts
  - E.g., EU/UK or APAC regulated = 15, NA = 5
- Short-term signal multiplier (0.8–1.4 applied to raw sum): based on 30/60/90 day trends
  - Active growth (>10% M/M usage or expansion) => 1.25–1.4
  - Flat => 1.0
  - Declining or multiple incidents => 0.8–0.9

Composite score = (Tier + ICP + Deployment + Region) * signal_multiplier
Priority buckets (suggested):
- Priority 1: composite >= 150 -> schedule deep QBR + exec outreach (within 2 weeks)
- Priority 2: composite 90–149 -> standard QBR (within 30 days) + playbook tasks
- Priority 3: composite < 90 -> self-serve QBR materials + renewal automation

Sample prioritized rows (toy data for Feb pilot):
- Atlas Commerce (acct-002): ARR $1.8M, Tier A (100), ICP 30, Deploy=Private (25), Region EU(15), usage +18% => raw=170, multiplier 1.25 => score 212.5 => Priority 1 => Owner: Priya Nair => Action: exec intro + SRE deep-dive on latency tail, propose Dedicated stable SLA
- ClearSight Media (acct-089): ARR $420k, Tier B (60), ICP 20, Deploy=Hosted(5), Region NA(5), usage -12% => raw=90, multiplier 0.85 => score 76.5 => Priority 3 => Owner: Jasper Lin => Action: automated renewal playbook, upsell nudges, check for billing issues
- FinBridge (acct-017): ARR $970k, Tier B (60), ICP 25, Deploy=Dedicated(15), Region APAC(15), usage flat => raw=115, multiplier 1.0 => score 115 => Priority 2 => Owner: Ethan Rodriguez => Action: technical QBR + review of quantization/throughput savings

Playbook snippets by priority:
- Priority 1 (high risk/high value):
  - Pre-QBR: AE/CS + Solutions Eng + SRE sync (share incident logs, perf dashboards)
  - Exec outreach: 30-minute call with Head of CS + customer exec, include roadmap alignment notes
  - Action items: propose dedicated capacity options, cost modeling, and a rollback/fallback routing policy for critical endpoints
  - Documentation: create a one-pager with SLA options + migration checklist

- Priority 2 (mid):
  - Pre-QBR: CS owner prepares usage trends, highlight one win and one risk
  - Technical: invite Solutions Eng for an enablement mini-session (30 mins) on latency/cost levers
  - Commercial: review license utilization and propose light uplift offers or trials

- Priority 3 (low touch):
  - Automated: send QBR slide deck + recording + renewal checklist via CS portal
  - Monitoring: set 90-day check-in cadence and automated health alerts to owner

QBR cadence mapping (suggested):
- Tier A / Priority 1: monthly commercial check-ins + quarterly executive QBRs
- Tier B / Priority 2: quarterly QBRs, monthly health calls optional for new deployments
- Tier C / Priority 3: semi-annual QBRs, rely on product-driven communications

Ownership & tooling notes:
- Source of truth: RevOps dataset (monthly snapshot) + SRE incident exports (linked in Confluence).
- Fold results into QBR Google Sheet template (linked artifact above) and mark rows with owner Slack handle.
- For private deployments, include infra change logs and KMS rotation dates in QBR package.

Operational checklist before a prioritized QBR:
- Validate ARR and billing (Revenue Ops)
- Confirm deployment type and responsible infra contact (Solutions Eng)
- Pull last 90-day errors/latency by route (SRE)
- Prepare cost vs quality tradeoff slide (CS + Product)
- Create exec one-pager (2 pages max) with ask (budget/SLA/engineering time)

Risk areas and open questions (for product/ops):
- How do we weight strategic logo importance vs ARR? (current rubric uses only ARR for Tier mapping)
- Should we treat models with custom weights/quantization differently for renewal risk?
- Data residency/regulatory score could be binary for some customers — should it be higher weight for FedRAMP-like deals?
- Need a rule for accounts using multiple deployment modes (hybrid): average or max of deployment score?

Next steps (Feb pilot):
- Run rubric on top 200 accounts by ARR and surface top 40 for pilot QBR owners (due 2025-02-21)
- Collect feedback from pilot owners + SRE on false positives/negatives
- Iterate weights and publish final lightweight template to Confluence and the QBR Google Sheet repo

Notes / references and quick links:
- RevOps ARR export location: gs://revops/monthly/arr-2025-01.csv
- SRE incident feed: https://sre.redwood.ai/incidents?range=90d
- Related Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CS/QBR+Templates+Sandbox
- Example Jira for pilot automation: JIRA-CS-1876

Comments (inline):
- Priya: We should consider product dependency (e.g., reranker vs embeddings) as an additional small modifier — will test in pilot
- Ethan: Can we get an automated signal for model-timeouts (99.9th pct) into the multiplier calculation? SRE to advise.
- Jasper: Suggest a one-click Slack workflow template to claim ownership of a prioritized QBR row (reduces manual assignment)

End of sandbox doc. Please add feedback inline or DM for quick sync.
